name: Zhuangyang Jiayao
source:
Hero is a narcissistic god on a training. While strengthening his spirit he has kept abstinence for 500 years and now he finally descends to the lower world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一个在训练中自恋的神。在强化神魂的同时，他禁欲了五百年，如今终于下凡了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-april-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
